recipe.visualDefinition: A trio of musicians in flamboyant, sequined 1980s stage attire standing in the middle of a city boulevard at dusk. The scene blends realistic photography with hyper-saturated, airbrushed illustrative qualities, featuring palm trees, neon billboards, and a deep blue-to-orange gradient sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Three figures arranged symmetrically across the center foreground
Deep blue asphalt reflecting city lights in the lower half
Silhouetted palm trees framing the right side against a sunset sky
Vertical city buildings and billboards framing the left side
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting with strong rim light on figures
Saturated cobalt blue and warm gold color palette
Presence of electric instruments (guitar, keytar, bass)
Low-angle perspective looking up at the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-length figures occupy the central horizontal band, scaled to dominate the mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure holding a keytar, positioned directly on the road's center line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central figure, move outward to the flanking musicians, then upward to the palm trees and sky, finally settling on the top-aligned text box.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is open sky, providing a clean area for the title block.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden Yellow and Orange (sunset and sequins)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright White and Cyan (neon lights and reflections)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation in the blues and yellows; dark values in the foreground road create a stage-like effect.
paletteRestrictions: Primary focus on the blue-gold complementary pair

letterConstructionRules: Slightly condensed proportions for the main title

composition.position: Top center within a rectangular box
composition.relationshipToImage: Contained in a dedicated cream-colored header box

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and scales of the same geometric sans-serif family to distinguish between artist names and album title.
graphicDevices: Rectangular header box with a thin black border
Horizontal rule lines separating text tiers

preserve: Cream background for the text box

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, condensed geometric feel of the main title.
Provides the clean geometric skeleton seen in the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle shot of a city street at dusk with a deep blue road reflecting yellow streetlights. Three men in 80s sequined outfits (gold, black, blue) stand in the center holding a guitar, keytar, and bass. Palm trees on the right against a sunset sky. Leave the top 15% of the frame clear for a text box.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a cream-colored rectangular box at the top center with a thin black border. Inside, typeset the artist names in a small geometric sans-serif, the main title in a large condensed bold sans-serif, and the subtitle in a medium sans-serif, all centered and in all-caps.

verificationChecks: Is the text box centered at the top?
Is the road color a saturated cobalt blue?
Are there palm trees on the right side?

adjustableVariables: Amount of reflection on the wet-look asphalt
Specific colors of the sequined outfits
Density of the city buildings in the background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Proprietary brand logos on instruments or billboards
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Dramatic stage-style lighting on the subjects

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered within the header box.
Check that the blue of the road doesn't bleed into the figures' legs.
Verify the keytar is held by the central figure.
Confirm the sky has a smooth gradient from orange to dark blue.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle urban dusk photograph with a high-contrast airbrushed finish, then frame the top with a structured, multi-tiered geometric sans-serif title block.
